latestVersion.changelog:
SEAP Shopping Skill initial release.

- Supports both immediate and scheduled (预约) purchases, whether the user is present or not.
- Searches and displays all matching products with full details for user selection.
- Address confirmation workflow: reads from configuration, allows user to confirm or edit address before purchase.
- Integrated with command-line tool for searching and buying; automates all relevant shell commands.
- Scheduled purchase task fully automates at specified time, pushing result to user with detailed notification.
- Robust state management: handles session files for search, confirmation, scheduling, and purchase results.
